g1.title: #303 — remove the target_mode concept end-to-end + gold report schema v5
g1.imperative: Remove the vestigial target_mode field everywhere (it is always 'retro_delta' post-#142). (a) latent_power: drop target_mode + ALLOWED_TARGET_MODES + its validation from config.py and models.py (LossBundle); make modules.loss_from_pairwise unconditional retro_delta (drop the target_mode branch/plumbing, keep the target_mu requirement and its named error); remove the target_mode echo from training.py diagnostics rows and loss payload (keep retro_delta semantics + batch.outcome for eval). (b) evo: drop target_mode='retro_delta' kwarg in run.py (line ~246); drop the target_mode field + VALID_TARGET_MODES + validation from gold_cycle/config.py and any target_mode entries in its serialized dicts (lines ~322,~362); drop the target_mode passthrough in gold_cycle/runner.py (~575). (c) Schema: VERIFY whether the committed gold report run_config actually carries target_mode (reports.build_run_config did NOT at audit time; config.py serialization may). Bump REPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION 4->5 in gold_cycle/reports.py to mark the run_config/diagnostics shape change for this work; add 5 to any report consumers/readers that pin supported versions; update the gold_report_schema.py field registry (schema_version interpretation -> v5; remove any target_mode field entry if present) and docs/report_schemas/* if such a doc exists. Note: the v5 contract also reserves the |r/sigma| percentile fields that G2 populates. (d) Update affected tests (tests/unit/latent_power/test_config.py,test_models.py,test_modules.py,test_training.py; tests/unit/evo_predictor/test_gold_cycle_config.py,test_gold_cycle_runner.py,test_gold_module_cycle.py; tests/integration/test_retro_delta_smoke.py). One canonical path; no vestigial mode field; no behavior change to training math.

g2.title: #304 phase 1 — surface |r/sigma| percentile instrumentation
g2.imperative: Extend the existing per-epoch r_over_sigma telemetry in latent_power/training.py from {p95,p99 on the last training batch} to a full percentile set {p50,p90,p95,p99} computed over the full validation/eval pairwise set, and surface those percentiles into (1) the persisted module training diagnostics (module_diagnostics.json) and (2) the gold report under the v5 fields declared in G1, tagged per-module so phase (quali/race_start/race) and scope (driver/constructor) are recoverable from existing module names. Add unit tests: percentiles present, finite, monotonic (p50<=p90<=p95<=p99); computed over the full eval set not just the last batch; gold report carries the fields. Capture a baseline |r/sigma| readout for the current promoted bundle gold_cycle_260530_042533_2018thru2024 (recompute from committed module_diagnostics or a no-train recompute) into .agent-work/sigma-calibration-followups/evidence/g2-rsigma-baseline.md. Keep latent_power domain-independent (no F1 phase/scope strings hard-coded in latent_power; tagging by module name happens on the evo/report side).

g3.title: #305 — optional separate Student-t nu for sigma-calibration term B
g3.imperative: Add student_t_nu_sigma: float | None = None to LatentPowerConfig with validation (None, or > 2.0 for finite Student-t variance). In modules.loss_from_pairwise, term B (the detached sigma Student-t NLL) uses (config.student_t_nu_sigma if not None else config.student_t_nu); term A (mean) keeps config.student_t_nu untouched. Wire end-to-end: run.py CLI arg --student-t-nu-sigma (default None), gold_cycle/config.py optional field + gold_cycle/runner.py _module_train_args passthrough. Unit tests: default None reproduces current shared-nu behavior exactly (loss values unchanged); setting student_t_nu_sigma changes only term B's nu and leaves term A's mu gradient unaffected; validation rejects values <= 2.0. No gold default change in this gate (knob only; the value to use, if any, is decided in G4).

preconditions.statement: g1 complete: target_mode cleanup landed (stable loss/config surface)

postconditions.statement: student_t_nu_sigma knob wired latent_power->CLI->gold; default None backward-compatible; suites green
reviewer approves (term-A nu untouched, term-B uses override, None is bit-for-bit current behavior, nu>2 validation, end-to-end wiring)

constraints: preserve Student-t heavy-tail robustness (nu>2); mu objective unchanged (term B detaches mu)

g4.title: #304 phase 2-3 + #306 — bounded research to written verdicts
g4.imperative: Using G2 instrumentation and the G3 knob, run bounded research (smoke / single-module, NOT a full gold cycle) and write verdicts. (A) nu sensitivity (#304): sweep nu in {2,3,4,6,8} on >=2 module families including driver_race_start_power_from_race_weekend (tight residuals) and a higher-variance quali module; readouts: |r/sigma| percentile shape, per-pair sigma std, corr(sigma_pi,log_loss), max delta pairwise log-loss. Verdict: keep shared nu=4, OR recommend ONE bounded default change (e.g. term-B student_t_nu_sigma=X) for G5; route deeper per-(phase,scope) nu tuning to a triage follow-up via flag-candidate. (B) race-start corr flip (#306): for driver_race_start_power_from_race_weekend export per-pair sigma + |r| distributions (current promoted bundle vs a fresh smoke), run an event-level outlier audit (leave-one-event-out + Spearman alongside Pearson), and a single-module lambda_sigma_nll sweep {0,0.5,1,2}; verdict: flat-signal artifact | needs lambda tuning | needs a per-pair uncertainty consumer. Save evidence/g4-nu-sweep.md, evidence/g4-racestart.md, and machine-readable JSON. Surface both verdicts + the recommended G5 setting (if any) to the human and get a decision.

preconditions.statement: g2 + g3 complete: instrumentation + term-B nu knob available

postconditions.statement: reviewer approves the evidence and verdicts

g5.title: Full gold retrain (always) + Brier-primary comparison + promote + docs
g5.imperative: Run ONE full gold cycle with the chosen settings from G4 (the approved default change if any, else current defaults) on schema v5 (producing the |r/sigma| fields). Produce: (1) Brier-primary comparison vs the current promoted baseline gold_cycle_260530_042533_2018thru2024 (log-loss + reliability supplemental) -> require no regression; (2) sigma_pi dynamic range + corr(sigma_pi,log_loss) deltas, including a race-start re-check against the G4 #306 verdict; (3) promote params/gold runtime bundles + uncertainty_calibration + sampled_runtime_manifest. Update docs: ADR 0008 (term-B nu knob, |r/sigma| instrumentation, schema v5, any default change), docs/architecture/packets/latent_power.md, gold_report_schema.py notes; reconcile happens at the spine reconcile step. Save evidence/g5-gold.md + evidence/g5-metrics-comparison.json. Closing issues #303-306 is deferred to the spine review/triage step (closing issues needs human approval).
